AfterAddedToRoom.rationale: SHARED-FINDINGS section 2's pool-wide verdict, copied not re-derived. The sim has no add-to-room phase -- creature creation IS construction -- so AfterAddedToRoom's effect (TerritorialPower 1 on itself, Byrdonis.cs:34-38) is applied from `__init__` (byrdonis.py:26-28). The game applies it from MonsterModel.AfterAddedToRoom (MonsterModel.cs:313-316 is a no-op base, so the override is the whole effect), awaited by CombatManager.AfterCreatureAdded inside StartCombatInternal, i.e. after every creature is on the board and before Hook.BeforeCombatStart. Same observable today on all three clauses SHARED-FINDINGS establishes by execution: (a) listener set -- the only ported listeners on the reachable hooks (relics/ruined_helmet.py:23-38, relics/unsettling_lamp.py:44-53, relics/vambrace.py:26-40, relics/paels_legion.py:36-43) all gate on the player and a monster's starting power/block is self-applied with no card; (b) HP-roll inversion -- of the 35 constructor-applied power classes only IllusionPower mentions max_hp and only inside revive() (powers.py:1581), never at apply time; (c) roll ordering -- all 29 machine sites are sticky-no-ops (monster_probes.py roll-order).  Rule 7: the four relic files and sts2_rl/powers.py named above are NOT hashed by this record (powers.py is hashed only where this record cites it with line numbers).

GenerateMoveStateMachine.rationale: A MachineMonster port, so the graph is comparable node for node. Byrdonis.cs:40-51 builds PECK_MOVE and SWOOP_MOVE, sets PECK.FollowUpState = SWOOP and SWOOP.FollowUpState = PECK, and -- the easy thing to get backwards -- passes moveState2 (SWOOP) as the INITIAL state, not the first-declared PECK. The port matches: swoop.follow_up = peck, peck.follow_up = swoop, MonsterMoveStateMachine([swoop, peck], swoop). No RandomBranchState anywhere, so no AddBranch integer to misread. Executed (`py audit/tools/monster_probes_b01.py machine`, seeds b01/b02, 40 turns): move sequences identical and 0 MonsterAi draws on both sides.
